ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In Figure A, E—F is a horizontal line from E on the left to F on the right; place 1, O, and place 2 are arranged in sequence on the E—F line, with place 1 on the left side of O and place 2 on the right side of O; the question stem states that the topographic profile made along E—F is Figure B. In Figure B, the profile line generally lowers from E on the left toward F on the right. Reasoning: Project the positions of place 1 and place 2 in Figure A onto the profile line in Figure B according to the order from E to F; place 1 is located at a relatively leftward position, and place 2 is located at a relatively rightward position. Since the profile in Figure B lowers from left to right, the elevation corresponding to place 1 is higher than that of place 2.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：甲图中，1地、O、2地排列在E—F线上，1在O左侧、2在O右侧；题干说明沿E—F作出的剖面是乙图。再推理：把甲图中1、2的位置按沿E到F的顺序投影到乙图的剖面线上。乙图剖面线从左侧E向右侧F总体降低，因此左侧的1地对应位置高于右侧的2地对应位置，得出1地比2地海拔高。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：甲图中，E—F 是一条由左侧 E 到右侧 F 的水平线，1地、O、2地依次排列在 E—F 线上，1地在 O 左侧，2地在 O 右侧；题干说明沿 E—F 作出的地形剖面是乙图。乙图中，剖面线从左侧 E 向右侧 F 总体降低。推理：把甲图中 1地、2地的位置按 E 到 F 的顺序投影到乙图剖面线上，1地位于较靠左的位置，2地位于较靠右的位置。由于乙图剖面由左向右降低，所以1地对应的海拔高于2地。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：甲图中，E—F 是一条由左侧 E 到右侧 F 的水平线，1地、O、2地依次排列在 E—F 线上，1地在 O 左侧，2地在 O 右侧；题干说明沿 E—F 作出的地形剖面是乙图。乙图中，剖面线从左侧 E 向右侧 F 总体降低。推理：把甲图中 1地、2地的位置按 E 到 F 的顺序投影到乙图剖面线上，1地位于较靠左的位置，2地位于较靠右的位置。由于乙图剖面由左向右降低，所以1地对应的海拔高于2地。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 候选推理符合题干、图像和标准答案。图像描述先于推理，且关键视觉信息（甲图中1、O、2沿E—F线由左到右排列；E—F剖面对应乙图；乙图剖面由E向F总体降低）均可由图中或题干支持。最终结论“1地海拔高于2地”与标准答案“高”一致。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct point-transfer route: it explicitly maps the numbered sites from the plan view onto the corresponding E—F profile and compares their vertical positions on that profile.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read 甲图 to see that 1地 and 2地 both lie on the horizontal E—F line, with 1地 to the left of O and 2地 to the right of O. Read 乙图 as the E—F地形剖面, where the profile descends from the E side toward the F side, so the projected position of 1 is vertically higher than the projected position of 2.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the statement that the profiles along E—F and M—N are respectively 乙图 and 丙图, and the question asks only about elevation comparison between 1地 and 2地.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In a地形剖面图, a point plotted higher on the vertical direction has greater elevation. Points on the same section line in the plan can be transferred to the corresponding positions on the profile by their order/distance along the line.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：乙图的E—F剖面显示从E端向F端为下坡趋势；甲图显示1地位于E—F线上靠E的一侧，2地位于同一线靠F的一侧。再推理：沿E到F方向海拔递减，所以靠E的1地处在上坡/高处，靠F的2地处在下坡/低处。因此1地比2地的海拔高。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中甲图为平面位置图，E在左侧、F在右侧，E—F线横穿甲图，1地位于E—F线上靠近E的一侧，2地位于同一线上靠近F的一侧。乙图标注为沿E—F所作的地形剖面，剖面线从E端向F端总体呈下降趋势。再推理：沿E到F方向海拔递减，因此靠E侧的1地海拔高于靠F侧的2地。
method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中甲图为平面位置图，E在左侧、F在右侧，E—F线横穿甲图，1地位于E—F线上靠近E的一侧，2地位于同一线上靠近F的一侧。乙图标注为沿E—F所作的地形剖面，剖面线从E端向F端总体呈下降趋势。再推理：沿E到F方向海拔递减，因此靠E侧的1地海拔高于靠F侧的2地。
method.CoT_qualify_0: 该推理链先描述图像再进行推理，顺序符合要求；图像描述中关于甲图E—F线、1地靠E侧、2地靠F侧，以及乙图E到F剖面总体下降的说法均可由图中直接支持。结论“1地海拔高于2地”与标准答案“高”一致。无需修改。
method.CoT_final: 先描述图像：图中甲图为平面位置图，E在左侧、F在右侧，E—F线横穿甲图，1地位于E—F线上靠近E的一侧，2地位于同一线上靠近F的一侧。乙图标注为沿E—F所作的地形剖面，剖面线从E端向F端总体呈下降趋势。再推理：沿E到F方向海拔递减，因此靠E侧的1地海拔高于靠F侧的2地。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Weakly distinct gradient-orientation route: instead of explicitly plotting both points, it first determines the overall elevation gradient along E—F from the profile and then applies the left/right ordering of the two sites in the plan view.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read 乙图 to identify that along the E—F transect the terrain height decreases from the E end toward the F end. Read 甲图 to identify that 1地 is nearer the E/west side and 2地 is nearer the F/east side on that same transect.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text only to confirm that 乙图 corresponds to E—F, so the gradient seen in 乙图 is the correct one for comparing 1地 and 2地.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Along a single transect, if the profile shows a downslope direction, any point farther upslope has higher elevation than a point farther downslope, assuming the compared points lie on that transect as shown.
